name: audit-sweep
description: Find issues from several angles at once, adversarially verify each one, fix what survives, and loop until a round finds nothing new.

target.help: What to audit — a path, a module, a document, a config.

focus.help: Narrow the sweep. Left empty, the finders use their own judgment.

fix.help: Whether to fix confirmed findings. Off by default: an audit that edits is no longer an independent check.

steering_examples.description: Audit src/personalclaw/auth/ for credential-handling problems. Report only; don't fix.
Two of the confirmed findings are the same bug seen from different angles — merge them and re-run the fix leg once.

example_outputs: a ranked list of confirmed findings with fixes
metadata.when_not_to_use: not for writing new code — use code-project

config.guidance: The finders were asked to be thorough, which makes some of these plausible rather than real. Refute the ones that are.

config.prompt: Fixing is off for this run. Approve to apply the confirmed findings anyway, or deny to keep this a report-only audit.
